text: Gus came down to the quay with Mabel. Mabel took one look at the man and sat down very fast.
I buy what the sea leaves behind. Your rocks have been generous lately.
Sell me the salvage rights, keeper, and I will forget your mother’s debt.
Nobody on the island knew about the debt. Nobody but Gus, a cat, a mouse…
and the woman who had walked back into the sea.
